description:
Cast Tempt with Vengeance with X equal to 5 by paying {5}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Nivix Guildmage's last ability by paying {2}{U}{R}, copying Tempt with Vengeance.
Resolve the copy of Tempt with Vengeance, creating at least five 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate four Elementals by tapping them, adding {2}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Nivix Guildmage's abilities any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.
